verification_requirements: strain energy consistency with applied work
all-domain contact and independent full-field checks
tolerance extremes and correlated process distributions
forward and return assembly, retention and relock

repair_replacement_and_failure_rules: Record fail, missing, invalid, repair and replacement distinctly; known fail is never erased by missing data.
No invented event is needed when no intervention occurred; an empty repair/replacement list can remain truthful.
Every actual repair/replacement binds original evidence, same specimen, strict start/end times, distinct old/new assembly revisions and a coherent nonoverlapping revision chain.
A changed assembly revision cannot inherit the prior G3/G4/G5 chain; archive the prior version and original decisions, then qualify the new current assembly from G3.
Do not relabel an old candidate/decision as current; retain historical originals and record the actual source/version binding.

reception_interface.placeholder_instruction: Replace WORK with the actual submission directory; the output directory must not already exist. This is a future receipt command, not an executed acquisition.
reception_interface.scope_rule: Byte receipt and declared structural/chronological admission only; no OEM applicability authentication, no physical truth proof, no physical gate pass.

engineering_acceptance_record_required_s.critical_supplier_scope_limit: The original V2 structurally checks 21 selected_part_revision references but does not authenticate supplier applicability. A model_literature or synthetic_fixture reference must not be counted as an engineering-qualified OEM fact solely because it is structurally accepted.
engineering_acceptance_record_required_s.physical_decision_source: The original physical evaluator plus authentic actual acquisition and source-bound engineering review; not this handoff or intake receiver.

concurrent_collection_rule: 資料可並行取得；dependencies限制工程接受和試驗晉級，不阻止先接收局部實際原件。
